description: Frozen denominator for transitive influence-revocation recovery (issue #686). One four-grant delegation chain sharing authority_root_ref root:alpha plus one unrelated standalone grant. Effects narrow strictly down the chain (ExternalEffect > ReversibleMutation > Candidate > Read) so parent edges validate. Tests build typed grants/closures from these identities with a single test fence; the closure history revision below must equal the evidence source_revision exactly.
